Method of Attack: Trojan that takes over Android device and spreads itself to other users
Auto-replies to messages on WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, Viber, Skype with links to download site to propagate malware
App disappears after installation to hide presence
Attack Vector: Links in WhatsApp group chat messages leading to malicious APK download
Indicators of Compromise: Links in group chat messages with text 'Apply New Pink Must Try New WhatsApp.'
